How elegantly placed. The pinned piece is bound to its king's line, and stepping off would leave that king open to attack.
This hands the other side a pin against a king. Once a piece is held in line like that, it can't step away without exposing the king behind it.
A stronger move would have pinned an enemy piece against its king, holding it in line. That elegant restraint went unused.
